attempted_claim: Let (H_{alpha,theta} phi)_n = phi_{n+1}+phi_{n-1}+f(theta+n alpha) phi_n on l^2(Z), with f real-valued, nonconstant, even and analytic on a strip, alpha Diophantine (||n alpha||_T >= c/(n (log n)^a) for all |n|>=1 for some c>0, a>1), and let kappa(E,0) be Avila's acceleration and S_3^+ = {E in sigma(H_{alpha,theta}) : kappa(E,0)=2, L(E,0)>0} with S_3^+ nonempty. Does H_{alpha,theta} have Anderson localization (pure point spectrum with exponentially decaying eigenfunctions) in S_3^+, for all such Diophantine alpha and for a.e. theta (in particular outside the explicit reflected-resonant set Theta_{c',b}^c)?
decisive_failure: Bounded single pass only: one finite-volume computational probe (Lyapunov slope scan, N=401 diagonalization, resonance statistics) plus analytic route mapping. No uniform two-scale large-deviation theorem, no Wegner or Green's-function bounds, no single- or double-resonance elimination, and no stratified duality closure were established; no infinite-volume spectral conclusion of any kind is drawn.
